title: fix(service-knowledge): record changes reach the knowledge index on a kernel with no realtime service
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP
Fixes #37954

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:托管云上的租户(没有实时服务的内核)新建、修改记录后,知识库搜索立刻能搜到新内容;删除记录后搜索不再返回它;业务保存不会因为向量计算变慢。
- 为什么做:知识库主题下“云上用知识库”的一部分,解决云端第 2 部分在等的“没有实时服务就不同步”的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某条记录的索引没跟上,搜索漏掉它,业务数据本身不受影响;可直接撤回本改动,回到只在启动时建索引。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

On a kernel with no `realtime` service (every hosted kernel), `KnowledgeServicePlugin` used to warn "event sync disabled" at `kernel:ready` and never see a later create, update or user delete. It now registers the data engine's `afterInsert` / `afterUpdate` / `afterDelete` hooks on every object a record-change source indexes (`KnowledgeRecordHooks`, new file), and each hook calls the same `handleRecordUpsert` / `handleRecordDelete` the realtime subscription calls.

- **Which trigger, and why (the card's "absent, or always" choice): hooks only when `realtime` is absent.** Measured reasons: (1) exactly-once holds by construction, since the plugin picks one trigger at `kernel:ready` from the same `getService('realtime')` the ObjectQL plugin reads to bridge events to the engine; (2) a realtime kernel is unchanged, so its pre-commit exposure (#37110) stays with #37735 as the dispatch says; (3) "always" would have had to cut the realtime handler's create/update/delete branches and its predicate-write branch that #37979 just landed. A realtime kernel keeps its subscription; no hook is registered there.
- **Off the response path, and after the commit.** The hook only hands the sync off and returns. The hand-off goes through the engine's public `runAfterOpenUnitsCommit` (the same seam `core/dispatch-loop.ts` uses): the sync starts once the unit of work open at the write commits, never when it rolls back, and at once (outside every unit) when none is open.
- **The seam this PR leaves for #37735:** `KnowledgeRecordHooks.deferRecordSync(run)`, one private method of about ten lines. Every hook-path sync leaves through it as a `handleRecordUpsert` / `handleRecordDelete` call. #37735 replaces its body with the queue enqueue (keeping the after-commit start), and points the realtime handler's two calls at the same seam.
- **Predicate writes: no `requestReconcile` on the hook path (a measured change of route).** The dispatch asked for the hook path's bulk/multi writes to go through #37979's `requestReconcile(object)`. Measured on the real engine: once an object carries an `afterUpdate` / `afterDelete` hook, a `multi: true` write gets one per-row dispatch for each matched row (`engine-update.ts` / `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`, `buildPerRowAfterContexts`), so every row is synced by id. Pinned by "a predicate write is synced row by row". A reconcile request on top would start a full source walk after each predicate write and repair nothing. The scheduled daily reconcile still runs. If the seat wants the request anyway, it is a five-line addition in `onWrite` keyed on the per-row dispatch.
- **What the after-write hook observes about the pre-commit exposure** (the note at `handleRecordUpsert`): the hook runs at the same moment as the realtime event, inside the write and before any unit around it commits. The hook path does not sync at that moment: `runAfterOpenUnitsCommit` holds the sync until the commit, so the re-read sees the committed row and a rolled-back write is never synced (pinned with a real `engine.transaction`). The realtime path's #37110 half is unchanged and stays with #37735.
- **The objects follow the sources.** A source registered or loaded later for a new object gets its hooks through `onSourcesChanged`, as the reap guards do. Teardown removes them by `packageId` (`unregisterHooksByPackage`) through the plugin's existing `unsubscribes` list.

Docs: `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` §6 gets a new subsection, "Without a realtime service: the after-write hooks", and its opening paragraph names both triggers. Changeset: `@objectstack/service-knowledge` patch.

## Tests

`src/__tests__/record-hooks-sync.test.ts` drives a real `ObjectQL` engine (hook dispatch, per-row predicate dispatch, units of work) over an in-test transactional driver, with no realtime service:

| Pin | Ablation (the mutation, then the red) |
|:---|:---|
| A create and an update are searchable without a rebuild | A5: no hook trigger (pre-fix plugin), 8 of 11 red |
| A user delete de-indexes | A4: no `afterDelete` hook, 3 red |
| A slow (held) embedder does not delay the write's response | A2: the hook awaits its syncs, red (`held` after 2 s) |
| Inside a unit, the sync starts after the commit; a rolled-back write is never synced | A3: start at once instead of `runAfterOpenUnitsCommit`, 2 red |
| With realtime composed, create/update/delete each reach the service once (`it.each` with and without realtime) | A1: hooks started also with realtime, the realtime case red |
| A predicate update/delete is synced row by row; a source added later is hooked; teardown removes the hooks | covered by A4/A5 |

## Acceptance notes

- **The per-row hook ceiling now applies on this composition.** A `multi: true` write to an indexed object on a kernel with neither `realtime` nor the audit plugin is now held to the engine's 10,000-row per-row hook ceiling, the same rule every object with a per-row hook already gets (the audit plugin's global after-write hooks put every business object under it on a standard kernel). Declared `Clause-②: no` as dispatched: no schema, accept set or export moves. The changeset and the docs name the refusal and its fix. If the seat reads it as a narrowing, the arm is `no (narrowing)`.
- **A recycle-bin restore runs no hooks** (ADR-0148 D2), so on a realtime-free kernel a restored row is not re-indexed by itself. Measured in the container run below. The docs and the changeset say so. Reported to the seat for filing; not fixed here.
- **The hook-path sync is in process.** A sync that has not finished when the process stops is lost, and the next reconcile repairs it. Durable delivery is #37735's queue.

## Verification

<details><summary>Container run: showcase without `realtime` (head 70ce66dfc8 plus a local, uncommitted config edit)</summary>

The showcase lists `realtime` in `requires`. It was removed locally, along with the showcase's one webhook (stack validation refuses a webhook without realtime), and the app was booted with `pnpm dev --fresh -p 38196` (boot log: `webhook-auto-enqueuer … hasRealtime:false`). Driven over REST, searched with `search_knowledge` over MCP:

- `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` with notes "Count the zephyrine pelicans…" answered 201 in 0.32 s. Search "zephyrine pelicans" returned 1 hit, the new record, with no rebuild.
- `PATCH …/showcase_task/ID` with notes "Ring the quokkabird colony…" answered 200. Search "quokkabird colony" returned 1 hit with the new snippet; "zephyrine pelicans" returned 0 hits.
- `DELETE …/showcase_task/ID` answered 200. Search "quokkabird colony" returned 0 hits.
- `POST …/showcase_task/recycle-bin/ENTRY/restore` answered 200. Search "quokkabird colony" returned 0 hits: the restore gap above.

The server was stopped and the config edit reverted.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`dispatch-gates --commands`: 100 families, run at 70ce66dfc8. 97 exit 0. `check:objectql-double-limit` exit 1 on the new test's driver double (it copied rows before the bound); fixed in a385bcf08b and re-run, exit 0. Three are NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met, not findings): `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` read dists of packages outside this closure; `check:type-check-debt` never got a turn on the shared verify lock. CI runs all three. `--ran` reconciliation: 100 derived, 97 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `overlap-check` against origin/main 4af32b99db: clean, exit 0.

</details>

**Read first:** `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-record-hooks.ts` (`onWrite` and `deferRecordSync`, the risk hunks), then the `kernel:ready` catch branch in `knowledge-service-plugin.ts`, then the rollback and slow-embedder pins in the test.

**Two-minute verification:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run src/__tests__/record-hooks-sync.test.ts`. Expect 11 passed, with the "slow embedder" and "rolls back" cases among them.
